# fossa_users (Data Source)





<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `search` (String) Search term to filter users by username, email, or full name (max 255)
- `sort` (String) Sort order for results. Use format `field_asc` or `field_desc`. Supported fields: username, full_name, email, created_at, last_visit.

### Read-Only

- `results` (Attributes List) Array of users (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--results))

<a id="nestedatt--results"></a>
### Nested Schema for `results`

Read-Only:

- `bitbucket_cloud` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--results--bitbucket_cloud))
- `created_at` (String) The date the user was created
- `demo` (Boolean) Whether the user is a demo user
- `email` (String) The user's email address
- `email_verified` (Boolean) Whether the user's email address has been verified
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the user is enabled
- `full_name` (String) The user's full name
- `github` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--results--github))
- `has_set_password` (Boolean) Whether the user has set a password
- `id` (Number) The user's unique identifier
- `install_admin` (Boolean) Whether the user is an install admin
- `is_service_account` (Boolean) Whether the user is a service account
- `joined` (String) The date the user joined the organization
- `last_visit` (String) The date the user last visited the organization
- `organization` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--results--organization))
- `organization_id` (Number) The organization the user belongs to
- `phone` (String) The user's phone number
- `role` (String) The user's role in the organization
- `sso_only` (Boolean) Whether the user is SSO only
- `super` (Boolean) Whether the user is a super user
- `teams_count` (Number) Number of teams the user belongs to
- `terms_agreed` (String) The date the user agreed to the organization's terms
- `tokens` (Attributes List) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--results--tokens))
- `updated_at` (String) The date the user was last updated
- `user_role` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--results--user_role))
- `username` (String) The user's username

<a id="nestedatt--results--bitbucket_cloud"></a>
### Nested Schema for `results.bitbucket_cloud`

Read-Only:

- `avatar_url` (String) The user's Bitbucket Cloud avatar URL
- `email` (String) The user's Bitbucket Cloud email address
- `name` (String) The user's Bitbucket Cloud username


<a id="nestedatt--results--github"></a>
### Nested Schema for `results.github`

Read-Only:

- `avatar_url` (String) The user's GitHub avatar URL
- `email` (String) The user's GitHub email address
- `name` (String) The user's GitHub username


<a id="nestedatt--results--organization"></a>
### Nested Schema for `results.organization`

Read-Only:

- `access_level` (String) The organization's access level
- `id` (Number) The organization's unique identifier
- `title` (String) The organization's title

- `meta` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--results--tokens--meta))
